hooks.name: Database Migration Security Review
hooks.description: Verify database migration files follow security and convention requirements when saved

action.prompt:
A database migration file was just saved. Please verify:
1. Every new table has ROW LEVEL SECURITY enabled (ALTER TABLE ... ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY)
2. Every new table has RLS policies defined (not just enabled)
3. No SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY appears in the migration
4. All timestamp columns use TIMESTAMPTZ (not TIMESTAMP)
5. All primary keys use UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
6. The migration follows the naming conventions in .kiro/steering/database-conventions.md
Report any violations found.
